market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC trading ~$80,500-$81,500 on May 7, 2026. Reaching $45,000 requires ~44% drawdown from current levels. ETH-low-since-Nov-2025 was ~$76k earlier in year (per coverage of recent BTC bottom near $76k). $45k would be far below that. Such drawdowns are possible in a deep bear market over 8 months but historically infrequent absent a macro shock; market price 0.275 looks too high.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro shock or major crypto crash could push BTC below $45k unexpectedly.
